description: Compare each patient's average GOT with the mean of the per-patient averages.

c.request: For each patient in `Laboratory`, show the patient ID, their average GOT, their average RBC, and their average GOT minus the overall average GOT. Use that one overall figure for every patient, and return nothing if it is missing. Ignore missing values. Sort by the difference, highest first with missing differences last, return the top 10, and don't round. Compare each patient's average GOT with the mean of the per-patient averages.
c.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS overall_avg FROM p) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.overall_avg AS got_diff FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_got - o.overall_avg) IS NULL, got_diff DESC LIMIT 10

b.request: For each patient ID in Laboratory, show the patient's average GOT, their average RBC, and the difference between their average GOT and the mean of all patients' average GOTs, where that mean is one shared value computed over the per-patient averages, ignoring NULLs, and where the difference is NULL if the patient's average GOT is missing. Sort by the difference descending with NULLs last, return the top 10, and don't round
b.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT ID, avg_got, avg_rbc, avg_got - (SELECT AVG(avg_got) FROM per) AS diff FROM per ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

a.request: For each patient in `Laboratory` (grouped by `ID`), give the patient ID, their average GOT, their average RBC, and their average GOT minus the mean of all patients' average GOT values. That single overall figure is used for every patient, and if it is missing, return no rows. Ignore missing values in all averages. Show the 10 patients with the largest difference, highest first with missing differences last, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS m FROM p) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.m AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_got - o.m) IS NULL, (p.avg_got - o.m) DESC LIMIT 10

d.request: For each patient in `Laboratory`, show the patient ID, their average GOT, their average RBC, and the difference between their average GOT and the mean of all patients' average GOT values (the mean of the per-patient averages, computed as a single overall figure and used for every patient; return nothing if that figure is missing). Ignore missing values, sort by the difference from highest to lowest with missing differences last, return the top 10, and don't round.
d.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_got) AS m FROM p) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.m AS diff FROM p CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (p.avg_got - o.m) IS NULL, diff DESC LIMIT 10
